response.justification: Bogdan has extensive fullstack experience across multiple domains, with a strong focus on TypeScript, React, and Node.js, which aligns well with the required skills. His background includes scalable systems, relational and NoSQL databases, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes), though his recent roles skew toward higher seniority. His open-source projects and workshops demonstrate a commitment to clean architecture and mentorship.
strengths: Extensive fullstack experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js across multiple industries
Proven expertise in scalable systems, databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB), and cloud services (AWS, Kubernetes)
Strong open-source contributions and mentorship through workshops, indicating a commitment to clean architecture and collaboration
concerns: Overqualified for a junior/mid-level role due to extensive senior-level experience and leadership positions
Limited direct experience with PostgreSQL (mostly MongoDB) and React (mixed with Ember.js), though adaptable
Work environment requires high on-site presence, which may not align with his remote/open-source focused roles
